component.name: NAM Plug
component.summary: Neural Amp Modeler CLAP audio plugin

description.p: NAM-Plug is a high-performance, ultra-low latency CLAP (CLever Audio Plug-in) audio plugin for real-time Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) simulation on Linux DAWs (Bitwig Studio, REAPER, etc.).

It embeds the NeuralAmpModeler-rs DSP engine, combining state-of-the-art neural guitar amplifier and pedal modeling with strict zero-allocation real-time safety, SIMD AVX2/FMA vectorization, and dual-oracle numerical parity (>136 dB SNR).

ul.li: Comprehensive neural architectures: WaveNet (A1/A2), LSTM, ConvNet, Linear FIR/FFT, and Sequential models.
Integrated speaker cabinet Impulse Response (.wav) loader with ultra-low latency UPOLS FFT partition convolution.
Native Minimum-Phase Polyphase Sinc Resampler (256 phases × 64 taps) seamlessly adapting 48 kHz models to 44.1, 96, and 192 kHz.
Hardware-accelerated Slint 1.18 GUI with native X11 XEmbed embedding into host plugin panels and Wayland/X11 floating windows.
Live (zero added latency, adaptive compute) and HQ/Offline modes with 2×/4× polyphase anti-aliasing oversampling.
Hard real-time audio thread determinism: zero heap allocations, zero mutex locks, and a 3-tier lock-free GC cascade.
IEC 60268-10 PPM adaptive mono/stereo VU metering, sample-accurate parameter automation, and dynamic Plugin Delay Compensation (PDC).
Release Receipts: Rust-based long-phase receipts, golden quick-receipt validation, and fail-closed certified-artifact identity checks.
Runtime Hardening: Adaptive worker polling, standardized host log alerts, asynchronous model loading, and proportional reset stabilization.
Latency Contract: Cab-sim reports the engine's constant partition-sized priming latency, with dry and wet paths aligned to the declared figure.
Quality Gates: Independent CI lint and quick jobs with engine provenance and always-uploaded evidence; typed phase-status carriers.
